entries.description: List of entry AssemblyScript source files to be compiled. Each item is a file path.

items.description: Path to an AssemblyScript entry file.

targets.description: Build targets configuration. Each property defines a build target with its own output and options.

OptionsSchema.description: Compiler options that control the build process and output.

exportStart.description: Name of the exported start function for the WebAssembly module.

exportRuntime.description: Whether to export the runtime from the WebAssembly module.

exportTable.description: Whether to export the function table from the WebAssembly module.

initialMemory.description: Initial memory size for the WebAssembly module, in kilobytes.

runtime.description: Type of runtime to use, either 'incremental' or 'radical'.

outFile.description: Path to the output WebAssembly (.wasm or .wat) file.

output.description: Path to the output WebAssembly (.wasm or .wat) file for this target.

debug.description: Enable debug information for this build target.

sourceMap.description: Generate source map for this build target.

optimizeLevel.description: Optimization level for this build target (higher means more optimization).

shrinkLevel.description: Shrink level for this build target (higher means smaller output).

use.description: Additional compiler flags or environment variables for this build target.
